settings.label: Logo
settings.info: The wordmark used in the nav, loader and footer. Leave empty to use the built-in logo.

settings.label: Logo size
settings.info: Height of the SABDIA wordmark in the nav (32px reads proportionate against the 80px bar; the site's earlier review used 38px). Mobile scales in step.

settings.label: Legal name
settings.info: Shown in the footer copyright.

settings.label: ABN
settings.info: Shown in the footer legal line, e.g. 12 345 678 901. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: QBCC licence number
settings.info: Queensland requires a licensed builder to show its QBCC licence number in advertising, and this website advertises the business. Leave empty to hide - but fill it in before launch.

settings.content: Colours flow into every page of the site. Off = the built-in Sabdia palette. Side margins, content width and section spacing are in the Layout group below.

settings.label: System

options.label: Brand kit - charcoal, warm grey, white; sans headings; no gold
Editorial - warm stone and gold, serif headings (the original)

settings.info: One switch for the whole site. Brand kit follows the Sabdia brand guidelines (#3d3d3d, #e5e2df, #f4f4f4) after the 11 Sep 2026 review: the gold and the italic serif read as generated. Editorial puts the original look back exactly.

settings.label: Heading font (Brand kit)
settings.info: Headings and titles when the system is Brand kit. The kit's DIN Next is not in Shopify's font library; Barlow is its closest match there and the default. The Editorial system keeps Cormorant Garamond.

settings.label: Body and interface font
settings.info: Paragraphs, labels, buttons, forms, the nav. Open Sans by default (the brand kit body face).

settings.label: Use the colours below
settings.info: Leave off to keep the palette of the chosen system. Turn on to apply your own colours site-wide.

settings.label: Gold - rules and borders
settings.info: Decoration only on light backgrounds; never body text (contrast).

settings.content: One place for the whole site's spacing. Every section reads these, so a change here moves every page together. The side margin is a share of the window, held between the phone and desktop limits, so a laptop and a large monitor read the same.

settings.label: Side margins (share of the window)
settings.info: 10% since 11 Sep 2026 (Naomi). 5% was the original tight setting.

settings.label: Side margins, most on a large screen
Side margins, least on a phone
Content width
settings.info: The widest the content runs before it centres with space either side.

settings.label: Space above and below sections
settings.info: 100 = as designed. Lower is tighter, higher is airier.

settings.label: Section label size
settings.info: The small tracked labels that open each section - ABOUT SABDIA, THE SABDIA STORY, FOR SALE. Was 10.5px; 13 since 11 Sep 2026 (Naomi: hierarchy).

settings.label: Agent Access
settings.info: Off = hidden everywhere until you are ready for agents: the menu and footer links (even when the Shopify menu still lists it), the Agent Enquiries buttons, the Agent Access enquiry type, the home Agent Access band and the page itself, which shows a short note pointing to the contact form. On = all of it back as designed.

settings.label: Guided Match (Find Your Home)
settings.info: Off (11 Sep 2026 review: parked until the match is perfected) hides every link to the guided match across the site and the page itself shows a short note pointing to the contact page. On shows it everywhere it is designed to appear.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Enquiry options
settings.default:
For Sale - Current Residences
Request a Viewing
Upcoming Releases
Agent Access
General Enquiry | Thank you for your enquiry. A member of the Sabdia team will be in touch shortly.
Custom build or renovation | Thank you so much for reaching out and for thinking of us for your project. At the moment we aren't taking on client builds or renovations - our focus is solely on designing and building our own development projects. We really appreciate your interest and support, and hopefully our paths cross in the future.
Careers | Thank you for your interest in working with Sabdia. We have your CV and will be in touch if there is a fit.
settings.info: One list for every enquiry form: the home page and the Contact page show exactly these, in this order. One option per line. The residences for sale follow the first line on their own (from each residence's Status). Add a tailored thank-you after a | on the same line. A Careers line asks for a CV instead of the buyer questions; Agent lines stay hidden while Features › Agent Access is off.

settings.label: Social share image
settings.info: Shown when pages are shared - 1200×630 works best.

settings.label: Homepage title in search results
settings.default: Sabdia Constructions | Luxury Home Builders and Developers, Brisbane
settings.info: The headline Google shows for the homepage, and the browser tab name. Google shortens anything much past 60 characters. Empty = the store's name on its own.

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.default: Boutique luxury home builder and developer delivering award-winning residences across inner Brisbane since 2013. Design. Develop. Construct.
settings.info: Shown in search results for the homepage.

settings.label: Browser tab name after each page
settings.info: Shows after the page's name in the browser tab and in search results: Contact | Sabdia Constructions. Empty = the page's name only.

settings.label: Enquiry handling
settings.info: Shopify mode emails each enquiry to the store's sender email (Settings → Notifications) and files the person under Customers. Sabdia API mode posts to the existing Vercel endpoint instead.

settings.content: Advanced - these keep the enquiry forms and walkthroughs working. Only change them with your developer.

settings.label: Forms endpoint
settings.info: Enquiries and subscriptions post here, into the Sabdia leads inbox.

settings.label: Privacy link beside forms
settings.info: Shown after the note under every enquiry form. Leave blank to hide.

settings.label: Privacy link goes to
settings.info: Defaults to /pages/privacy.

settings.label: Media library base URL
settings.info: Where walkthrough frames and clips are stored.

settings.label: Storage service URL
settings.info: Where a Careers CV is uploaded to (the media library's service).

settings.label: Storage public key
settings.info: The public (anon) key. It can only add files to the careers folder; it cannot read or delete anything.

settings.label: Careers folder
settings.info: CVs land here (Supabase › Storage › careers). Private: only you can open them.

settings.content: Small words that appear on residence cards across the site.

settings.label: For-sale chip
settings.info: Wording on cards whose Status is For Sale. Other statuses (Under Offer, Coming Soon…) print their own word - Products › the residence › Status.

settings.label: Residence pages
settings.default:
aether
sierra
solace
caspian
qasr
capri
settings.info: The residences that live as pages (Content › Pages, one page handle per line), in the order lists show them. Each page's Status decides For Sale or Sold, exactly as the product did. The residences moved from products to pages on 15 Sep 2026.

settings.label: Sold badge
settings.info: Wording on cards whose Status is Sold Prior to Completion. A residence whose Status is plain Sold prints Sold.

settings.content: Words the site shows on every page while a form sends, once it has sent, and on a few buttons. Each page's own words (headings, labels, buttons) are in that page's sections.

settings.label: When a form can't send
settings.default: Something went wrong — please try again.

settings.label: When the spam check fails
settings.default: The spam check did not pass — please press the button again.

settings.label: When no location is ticked
settings.default: Please choose at least one location

settings.content: The thank-you panel's heading is a greeting and the person's first name (Good morning, Mark). The message under it is the chosen enquiry option's own thank-you (Contact › Enquiry options, or a residence page's Enquiry types), else the first reply below whose topic the enquiry mentions, else the thank-you message.

settings.label: Thank-you message
settings.default: Thank you for your interest - we appreciate you reaching out. A member of our team will be in touch with you as soon as possible.

settings.label: Reply - custom build or renovation
settings.default: Thank you so much for reaching out and for thinking of us for your project. At the moment we aren't taking on client builds or renovations - our focus is solely on designing and building our own development projects. We really appreciate your interest and support, and hopefully our paths cross in the future.
settings.info: When the enquiry mentions a renovation, a custom or client build, their own block or land, a knock-down, an extension or a quote.

settings.label: Reply - agents
settings.default: Thank you for reaching out. We will review your details and be in touch about agent access as soon as possible.
settings.info: When the enquiry mentions an agent, an agency or a licence.

settings.label: Reply - inspections
settings.default: Thank you for your interest - we appreciate you reaching out. Inspections are by private appointment. To help us provide the most relevant information, could you please share your approximate budget range and your intended timeline for purchase? A member of our team will then be in touch to arrange a time.
settings.info: When the enquiry mentions an inspection, a viewing, a walkthrough or an open home.

settings.label: Reply - price
settings.default: Thank you for your interest - we appreciate you reaching out. We talk through pricing directly rather than publishing a guide. To help us provide the most relevant information, could you please share your approximate budget range and your intended timeline for purchase? A member of our team will then be in touch with you as soon as possible.
settings.info: When the enquiry mentions a price, a guide, cost, how much or a budget.

settings.label: Reply - about Sabdia
settings.default: Thank you for reaching out. Sabdia is a boutique Brisbane developer, in-house from the first sketch to handover, with more than 100 homes since 2013. A member of our team will be in touch with you as soon as possible.
settings.info: When the enquiry asks about Sabdia, the company, the team or its history.

settings.label: Find your home - thank-you heading
settings.info: Shown when the Find your home page reloads after sending and its own thank-you is missing.

settings.label: Find your home - thank-you message
settings.default: We have your answers and will be in touch within a business day.

settings.label: Newsletter thank-you (fallback)
settings.info: Used only when the footer's own Newsletter thank-you is empty.

settings.label: After a file that isn't a PDF or Word file
settings.default: is not a PDF or Word file

settings.label: Added to the thank-you when a document didn't upload
settings.default: Not every document uploaded this time, so please email your CV to sales@sabdia.com.au.

settings.label: Copy link, when the browser won't copy
settings.info: Shown in a small pop-up above the link.

settings.label: Film sound button while the sound is on
settings.info: The button's word while the sound is off is set in each film's section (Sound button).
